name: fintorq-code-style
description: Project coding conventions for Fintorq Java backend code; excludes business rule and content validation.

interface.longDescription: Review and implement Fintorq Java code following the project's naming, layering, persistence, security, exception-handling, and testing conventions. Business rule and content validation are outside this plugin's scope.
defaultPrompt: Review this code against Fintorq coding conventions.
Implement this Java change using Fintorq coding conventions.
Check this module for Fintorq code style violations.
